errors.text_span: CoD (Chain of Thought), CoT (Chain of Thought)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly expands the abbreviation CoD as 'Chain of Thought'. While CoT stands for Chain of Thought, CoD stands for Chain of Density according to the source paper. This is external information that is also incorrect.

errors.text_span: и други базов модели
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly refers to the 'CCoT' category as 'други базов модели' (other baseline models). CCoT is a specific model, not a general category.

errors.text_span: върху четири различни задачи по логическо разсъждение (LRMs)
errors.evidence: This information is taken from the paper's caption, not from the visual content of the chart itself.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите на моделите, подредени азбучно: CoD, CoUT, CoT и други базов модели.
errors.evidence: The categories are not explicitly labeled on the horizontal axis. Furthermore, they are not sorted alphabetically as claimed. The order in the legend is CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT.

errors.text_span: с интервали от 10%
errors.evidence: The left y-axis for Accuracy has tick marks at intervals of 5 (70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 100), not 10.

errors.text_span: Вляво на осите на Y е обозначен етикет със стойност 91.19, което представлява най-ниската стойност, а вдясно е етикет със стойност 800, представляващ най-високата стойност.
errors.evidence: This sentence is highly confusing and inaccurate. It mistakes a data label (91.19) for an axis label, incorrectly states that 91.19 is the lowest value (it's the highest accuracy value), and mischaracterizes the 800 on the y-axis (it's the maximum value of the axis scale, not a data value).

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по низходящ ред
errors.evidence: This is only true for the 'Token Count' part of the chart. The bars in the 'Accuracy' part of the chart are not in descending order (91.19, 80.89, 88.50, 88.40).

errors.text_span: Стълбовете CoT са оцветени в зелено, стълбовете CoD са оцветени в жълто, стълбовете CoUT са оцветени в червено и другите базов модели са оцветени в синьо.
errors.evidence: The mapping of colors to categories is completely incorrect. The correct mapping is: CoT is red, CoD is orange, CCoT is light blue, and CoUT is green.

errors.text_span: Още свързана информация е етикетирана в долната част на графиката с "Average Performance and Tokens".
errors.evidence: There is no label with the text 'Average Performance and Tokens' on the chart. This text is from the paper's caption.
The description fails to explain the fundamental dual-axis structure of the chart, which is divided into two sections: 'Accuracy (%)' on the left and 'Token Count' on the right.
The description completely omits any mention of the right-hand y-axis, which represents 'Token Count' and has a scale from 0 to 800.

errors.text_span: This bar chart illustrates the average performance, expressed as accuracy percentage, and the corresponding token count for four different models: CoUT, CoD, and CoT, alongside several baseline models.
errors.evidence: The chart shows four categories (CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT), but the description only lists three, omitting CCoT. It also misunderstands the structure, treating it as a single chart instead of two side-by-side charts for two different metrics.

errors.text_span: alongside several baseline models
errors.evidence: The chart does not provide any information about which models are baselines. This is an unsupported interpretation.

errors.text_span: arranged alphabetically from CoD to CoT
errors.evidence: The categories on the horizontal axis are CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT, which is not alphabetical order.
The description completely omits the second y-axis on the right, which represents 'Token Count' and ranges from 0 to 800.

errors.text_span: with tick intervals of 10%
errors.evidence: The tick intervals on the left y-axis (Accuracy) are 5%, not 10% (e.g., 70, 75, 80...).

errors.text_span: extends up to 95%
errors.evidence: The accuracy axis extends to 100%, not 95%.

errors.text_span: including labeled values of 88.40, 89.50, 91.19, and 95.00
errors.evidence: This confuses data labels with axis labels and includes hallucinated values. The actual accuracy values are 91.19, 80.89, 88.50, and 88.40. The values 89.50 and 95.00 do not appear on the chart.

errors.text_span: The bars are colored red for CoUT, orange for CoD, and blue for CoT
errors.evidence: The color mapping is incorrect. According to the legend and chart, red is for CoT (not CoUT), and light blue is for CCoT (not CoT). The green color for CoUT is also omitted.

errors.text_span: The bar for CoUT reaches a height of approximately 89.50%
errors.evidence: The accuracy for CoUT is 88.40%, not 89.50%. The value 89.50 is hallucinated.

errors.text_span: the bar for CoD reaches approximately 88.40%
errors.evidence: The accuracy for CoD is 80.89%. The value 88.40% belongs to CoUT.

errors.text_span: and the bar for CoUt reaches approximately 95.00%
errors.evidence: There is no category 'CoUt' (note the typo) and no bar has a value of 95.00%. This is a hallucination.

errors.text_span: with values of 445.91, 534.24, 676.85, and 800 respectively
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists the token count values. The value 800 is the maximum of the axis, not a data point. The fourth data point is 354.46. The order of values is also not mapped correctly to the categories.

errors.text_span: All bars are presented in their original order, with the CoUT, CoD, CoT, and CoUt bars aligned horizontally for comparison.
errors.evidence: This statement misrepresents the chart's structure. The chart has two groups of bars (one for Accuracy, one for Token Count), not a single horizontal alignment of bars for one metric. The listed order of categories is also incorrect and includes a hallucinated category ('CoUt').

errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse zeigt die Modellnamen: CoT, CoD, CCoT und CoUT.
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is not labeled. The model names (CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT) are defined in the legend at the bottom of the chart.

errors.text_span: reicht von 70 % bis 95 %
errors.evidence: The left vertical axis, representing Accuracy (%), ranges from 70 to 100, not 70 to 95.

errors.text_span: von 354,46 bis 800
errors.evidence: The right vertical axis for Token Count ranges from 0 to 800. 354.46 is the lowest data value, not the start of the axis range.

errors.text_span: Bögen
errors.evidence: The chart measures "Token Count", a dimensionless quantity. The unit "Bögen" (arcs/sheets) is not mentioned in the figure and is incorrect.

errors.text_span: Der rote Balken für CoT erreicht einen Wert von 88,50 %, der grüne Balken für CoD erreicht einen Wert von 80,89 %, der gelbe Balken für CCoT einen Wert von 88,40 %, und der blaue Balken für CoUT einen Wert von 91,19 %.
errors.evidence: This sentence completely scrambles the colors, models, and accuracy values. The correct values are: CoT (red) = 91.19%; CoD (orange) = 80.89%; CCoT (light blue) = 88.50%; CoUT (green) = 88.40%. For example, it states the red CoT bar is 88.50% (it is 91.19%) and calls the light blue CCoT bar yellow.
The description fails to mention that the chart has two distinct vertical axes: a left axis for "Accuracy (%)" and a right axis for "Token Count". It conflates them into a single description.
